gl:definition.gl:content: defined characteristic suitable for the description and differentiation of products or components

gl:notes.gl:content: The concept of type and instance applies to properties.
This definition applies to properties as described in IEC 61360/ ISO 13584-42.
The property types are defined in dictionaries (like IEC component data dictionary or ECLASS), they do not have a value. The property type is also called data element type in some standards.
The property instances have a value and are provided by the manufacturers. A property instance is also called property-value pair in certain standards.
Properties include nominal value, actual value, runtime variables, measurement values, etc.
A property describes one characteristic of a given object.
The specification of a property can include predefined choices of values.

gl:ref.gl:source: IDTA-01001-3.2:2026 (Specification of the Asset Administration Shell — Part 1: Metamodel)
